fields.title: Title
fields.name: title
fields.description: The optimal length of a meta title is around 50-60 characters. A well-written meta title can improve click-through rates and search engine rankings. It should accurately describe the content of the webpage while including relevant keywords.

fields.title: Description
fields.name: description
fields.description: The optimal length for a meta description is around 155-160 characters, and it should include relevant keywords and a clear call-to-action. A well-crafted meta description can improve click-through rates and encourage users to visit the webpage by providing an enticing and accurate summary of the content

fields.title: Tags
fields.name: tags
fields.description: Tags are like descriptive labels that are attached to specific content on a website, helping users quickly identify related information and find what they are looking for.

fields.title: Category
fields.name: categories
fields.description: Categories are like broad folders on a website that group together related content, making it easier for users to navigate and find information.
